dataset.name: FUSCC sunitinib-treated clear-cell renal carcinoma cohort (2023)
dataset.description: Independent Chinese clear-cell renal-cell carcinoma cohort with pretreatment bulk tumor RNA-seq and individual progression-free and overall-survival follow-up during sunitinib therapy.
dataset.cohort_context: FUSCC retrospectively assembled 115 advanced or subsequently recurrent clear-cell renal-cell carcinomas treated with sunitinib. Ninety-four pretreatment tumors have public RNA-seq profiles and complete study-defined PFS and OS fields. This treatment-selected cohort remains separate from untreated primary-tumor and randomized-trial KIRC cohorts.

metadata.source_program: Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center sunitinib cohort
metadata.library_method: Fresh-frozen pretreatment tumor bulk RNA sequencing on Illumina HiSeq 4000; gene-level FPKM supplied by the authors
metadata.endpoint_context: Study-defined progression-free and overall survival during follow-up of sunitinib-treated advanced or recurrent ccRCC
metadata.redistribution_note: The article and its supplementary data are distributed under CC BY 4.0.
metadata.curation_note: The public expression workbook contains 94 unique ccRCC sample columns that all map exactly to the 115-row clinical workbook. Eligibility is outcome-independent and requires an expression column plus positive 2021.12 PFS or OS time with an explicit 0/1 status. The source matrix contains 18,578 unique symbols; 7,370 genes with one or more missing values across the 94 patients are excluded without imputation, leaving 11,208 complete genes. The clinical catalog marks one additional sample, ccRCC_43, as RNA-sequenced, but that identifier is absent from the published quantification matrix and is therefore excluded.

samples.sample_role: Fresh-frozen pretreatment tumor used for bulk RNA sequencing

expression.label: log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Gene symbols supplied in the pinned Supplementary Data 3 workbook
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The 18,578 source feature symbols are unique exactly and case-insensitively; no implicit aggregation is performed.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer excludes every gene with a missing value in any retained patient, then applies log2(FPKM + 1) to the 11,208 complete published gene rows.

endpoints.label: Study-defined progression-free survival
endpoints.time_origin: Study-defined sunitinib-treatment follow-up; the exact calendar origin is not stated in the public supplement
endpoints.event_definition: Progression event recorded by the publication

endpoints.label: Study-defined overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Study-defined sunitinib-treatment follow-up; the exact calendar origin is not stated in the public supplement
endpoints.event_definition: Death recorded during follow-up; the article describes all 84 deaths in the full cohort as deaths from ccRCC
